attempts.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca), signed the ed25519 host key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with principals node1 and its IP, configured sshd via HostCertificate, and validated that a client trusting only the CA (@cert-authority line, no pinned host key) connects successfully with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, while a client with no CA trust and no pinned key is rejected. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id/service baseline, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified CA-based cert trust still works post-restart. All temporary test keys/known_hosts artifacts were cleaned up; the CA and host certificate configuration remain in place.
